detailed_descriptions.en: Dorfromantik in the Middle Ages The Medieval Biome Pack takes your Dorfromantik landscapes into the middle ages. Discover three vibrant new biomes shaped by the turning of the seasons and watch your tiles leap through time into a world of castles and timber-framed villages! Build idyllic landscapes, complete quests, and place each piece with care as you shape your worlds, now in a new medieval coat­. Iconic Landmarks Leap Through Time Within those new biomes you’ll find a reimagined version of each iconic Special Tile. The ruined walls of the old castle are rebuilt and rise above your landscape. The Steamboat becomes a medieval trading cog. And above it all, the sails of the windmill keep turning, now in a more rustic design. Features • 3 Additional Seasonal Biomes • All Buildings re-imagined in a Medieval Style • Mighty Castles • Medieval Trading Ship • Cozy half-timbered village houses • 2 Additional Music Tracks What NOT to expect: • Additions or changes in game mechanics, balancing or difficulty • New gameplay, quests or achievements • New inhabitants (animals, humans) Please note: This pack contains cosmetic changes only. Gameplay mechanics remain unchanged, and your established high score strategies remain unchanged with them. This biome pack is for you if you love Dorfromantik just the way it is, but enjoy immersing yourself in a cozy, medieval-inspired world.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Dorfromantik in the Middle Ages

The Medieval Biome Pack takes your Dorfromantik landscapes into the middle ages. Discover three vibrant new biomes shaped by the turning of the seasons and watch your tiles leap through time into a world of castles and timber-framed villages! Build idyllic landscapes, complete quests, and place each piece with care as you shape your worlds, now in a new medieval coat­.

Iconic Landmarks Leap Through Time

Within those new biomes you’ll find a reimagined version of each iconic Special Tile. The ruined walls of the old castle are rebuilt and rise above your landscape. The Steamboat becomes a medieval trading cog. And above it all, the sails of the windmill keep turning, now in a more rustic design.

Features

• 3 Additional Seasonal Biomes

• All Buildings re-imagined in a Medieval Style

• Mighty Castles

• Medieval Trading Ship

• Cozy half-timbered village houses

• 2 Additional Music Tracks

What NOT to expect:

• Additions or changes in game mechanics, balancing or difficulty

• New gameplay, quests or achievements

• New inhabitants (animals, humans)

Please note: This pack contains cosmetic changes only.

Gameplay mechanics remain unchanged, and your established high score strategies remain unchanged with them.

This biome pack is for you if you love Dorfromantik just the way it is, but enjoy immersing yourself in a cozy, medieval-inspired world.
